newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Midopa shares open limit down.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Midopa shares open limit down.

text.p: Shares in Midopa Department Store Co Ltd opened at their lower limit on Wednesday, pressured by news that the Federation of Korean Industries was considering intervening in a takeover bid for the retailer, brokers said.
The shares opened at 29,900 won, down 2,500 from the previous close.
Shindongbang Corp has said it was considering launching a hostile takeover bid for Midopa.

On Tuesday the federation, which represents the interests of major South Korean corporations, urged Midopa and Shindongbang to compromise. "If they fail, we plan to intervene to settle the issue," a senior federation official said.
Brokers said this was a bad sign for the future trend of mergers and acquisitions (M&As) in South Korea.
"Investors will be disappointed by the conglomerates' reaction to M&As, and the M&A theme might not be as strong as before," said Joo Hwan of HG Asia.
